name: better-answers
description: Better Answers — a living company knowledge map for UK SMBs on OKF v0.2 (see AGENTS.md)

scripts.prepare: lefthook install || echo 'lefthook is absent — no git hooks installed (see lefthook.yml)'
scripts.check:gates: node scripts/check.mjs format:check lint comment-gate:ts comment-gate:python comment-density insert-scan jscpd knip
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/check.mjs format:check check:docs:api check:docs:core check:docs:web
scripts.check:docs:api: pnpm --filter @better-answers/api exec vitest run tests/adr-index.test.ts tests/avoid-words.test.ts tests/coding-rules-form.test.ts tests/coding-rules-tags.test.ts tests/deploy-tree.test.ts tests/docs-lane.test.ts tests/provision-skills.test.ts
scripts.comment-gate:ts: oxlint --config packages/devtools/lint-rules/comment-gate.oxlintrc.json apps packages scripts jscpd.config.mjs knip.config.ts
scripts.comment-gate:python: python3 packages/devtools/python/comment_gate.py apps packages .github deploy .claude/hooks scripts cubic.yaml lefthook.yml pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.comment-density: node scripts/comment-density.mjs apps packages --directory .github --directory deploy --directory packages/schema/migrations --directory .claude/hooks --directory scripts --unit the-root-tool-configuration=cubic.yaml,jscpd.config.mjs,knip.config.ts,lefthook.yml,pnpm-workspace.yaml
